content_zh:
苏姨意外的挑了挑眉，那名白发老者也收起了脸上的和善笑容。
“你什么意思？”苏姨迅速观察四周，压低声音道。
“因为今天发生了一件很奇怪的事情。”顾青山道。
“什么事？”
“张野悄悄在我的汤里，掺加了一些药剂，然后又怂恿我来向苏雪儿表白。”
顾青山见两人听的专注，就连苏雪儿也默默的听着，便接着慢慢说下去。
“万一我拒绝了他，说不定他就会去想别的办法，所以我索性顺着他，搞了这么个仪式，看看他到底想干什么。”
“这么说，你吃下了那种药？”苏姨眯了眯眼，问道。
“对，还有这个。”顾青山伸出手指。
一根带血的黑针，被他拈在手中！
“什么！”张野失声道。
明明自己已经抽回了这根针，他什么时候拿走的？
望着这根针，苏姨这下真的变了颜色。
她与白发老者对望一眼，两个人都严肃起来。
自从苏大小姐认识了顾青山，苏家就对顾青山的背景有过详细调查，经过两年多的接触，对其心性为人也了若指掌。
所以，当顾青山像往常一样靠近苏雪儿之时，两名护卫并不是很在意。
谁知道，偏偏问题就出在他身上。
“你可有什么地方感觉不对劲？”苏雪儿走过来，缓声道。
她表现的平平淡淡，但顾青山却听出了她松弛语气中隐隐的焦急。
“大约是挑动欲望一类的药剂。”顾青山淡然道。

“咦？怎么会是那样的药剂。”苏雪儿说着，脸却有些渐渐红了。
她再怎么聪慧，毕竟只是个少女。
苏姨摸出一柄匕首，在顾青山手指上划出一道伤口，然后伸出舌头尝了尝血。
“恩，”苏姨咂咂嘴，“果然是同一种情药，还是十分猛烈的那种。”
她的眼神变得有些古怪：“小子，这你都能忍得住。”
顾青山道：“我忍的很努力。”
他动用丹田内的灵力，死死压制住情毒。
这个世界从未出现灵力这种东西，顾青山也不愿将自己的秘密暴露出来。
苏雪儿吸了口气，拉着苏姨的手道：“姨，你救救他。”
苏姨摸出一个小瓶子，倒出一粒白色胶囊，递到顾青山面前：“吃下去。”
说着，看顾青山的眼神已是分外柔和。
想不到这小子倒是心细懂事，这次还不错。
顾青山接过胶囊一口吃下，说道：“现在看来，他的目的是想让我和苏雪儿当众出丑。”
几人齐齐转过头来，望向张野。
张野眼见事情败露，整个人已经惊慌失措。
他忽然转过身，迈开步子就想逃走。
两名护卫见状，心中更是恼怒。
事已至此，整件事情基本清楚了。
顾青山平日经常与自家小姐接触频繁，所以两人不会对他太过防备。
在毕业晚会这样的正式场合，他们更多的是警惕着那些陌生的面孔。

一旦顾青山突然做出失礼的举动，他们很有可能来不及阻止。
众目睽睽之下，小姐当众被顾青山轻薄，名誉必定严重受损，他们两人也会为之手脚大乱。
若是酒会中暗藏的还有其他后手，说不定对方还能趁着混乱，寻找到刺杀小姐的机会。
白发老者身形一闪，已经堵在了张野面前。
“来吧，小子，世事艰辛，何不坠入黑甜梦乡。”
老者吟唱着，用粗糙大手抓住了张野的天灵盖，缓缓闭上眼睛。
奇怪的事发生了。
当老者闭上双眼，张野也跟着闭上了双眼。
老者继续用古怪的语调吟唱着，就像恶魔在诱惑凡人：“来来来，只要将你的秘密说出来，我就会满足你心中所有的愿望。”
张野脸上流露出痴痴的笑，口中喃喃道：“我告诉你，我马上告诉你。”
这奇特的一幕，引来了围观人群的窃窃私语。
顾青山也意外道：“这难道是天选技？”
苏雪儿站在他身侧，小声道：“没错，李爷爷是一名善于寻找真相的天选者。”
天选者是掌握了特殊能力的职业者，这一类能力非常神秘，往往随着人的生长发育而逐渐显现。
这样的能力，后天修炼根本无法学会，更没有人能够干预，就像是上天注定一样。
故此，拥有这些能力的人，被称作天选者。
在现实世界中，人族的高端战力分为四类，分别是天选、武道、超凡、神裔，每一类侧重的方向都不相同。

content_en:
Aunt Su raised her eyebrows in surprise, and the white-haired old man also put away the kind smile on his face.
"What do you mean?" Aunt Su quickly looked around and asked in a low voice.
"Because a very strange thing happened today." Gu Qingshan said.
"What's the matter?"
"Zhang Ye secretly added some medicine into my soup, and then encouraged me to confess to Amelia Su."
Gu Qingshan saw that the two of them were listening intently, and even Su Xueer was listening silently, so he continued speaking slowly.
"If I reject him, maybe he will think of other ways, so I simply followed him and performed such a ritual to see what he wanted to do."
"So, you took that medicine?" Aunt Su narrowed her eyes and asked.
"Yes, there is also this." Gu Qingshan stretched out his finger.
A bloody black needle was held in his hand!
"What!" Zhang Ye lost his voice.
He had obviously withdrawn the needle, when did he take it away?
Looking at the needle, Aunt Su really changed her color.
She and the white-haired old man looked at each other, and both of them became serious.
Ever since Miss Su met Gu Qingshan, the Su family has conducted a detailed investigation into Gu Qingshan's background. After more than two years of contact, they have a good understanding of his character.
Therefore, when Gu Qingshan approached Su Xueer as usual, the two guards did not pay much attention.
Who knows, but the problem lies with him.
"Do you feel something is wrong?" Su Xueer walked over and said slowly.
She acted calmly, but Gu Qingshan could hear the underlying anxiety in her relaxed tone.
"It's probably a drug that arouses desire." Gu Qingshan said calmly.
"Eh? How could it be such a potion?" Su Xueer said, but her face gradually turned red.
No matter how smart she is, she is just a girl after all.
Aunt Su took out a dagger, made a cut on Gu Qingshan's finger, and then stuck out her tongue to taste the blood.
"Well," Aunt Su smacked her lips, "it is indeed the same love potion, and a very strong one."
Her eyes became a little weird: "Boy, you can bear this."
Gu Qingshan said: "I endured it very hard."
He used the spiritual power in his Dantian to suppress the love poison.
There has never been such a thing as spiritual power in this world, and Gu Qingshan is unwilling to expose his secret.
Amelia Su took a breath, took Aunt Su's hand and said, "Auntie, please save him."
Aunt Su took out a small bottle, poured out a white capsule, and handed it to Gu Qingshan: "Take it."
As he said that, his eyes looking at Gu Qingshan were extremely soft.
Unexpectedly, this boy is very thoughtful and sensible, so this time he was not bad.
Gu Qingshan took the capsule and ate it in one gulp, and said, "Now it seems that his purpose is to make me and Su Xueer embarrassed in public."
Several people turned their heads and looked at Zhang Ye.
Zhang Ye was in panic when he saw what happened was revealed.
He suddenly turned around and took steps to escape.
When the two guards saw this, they were even more angry.
At this point, the whole thing is basically clear.
Gu Qingshan often has frequent contact with his young lady, so the two of them will not be too defensive about him.
In formal occasions such as graduation parties, they are more wary of unfamiliar faces.
Once Gu Qingshan suddenly makes a rude move, they may not be able to stop him in time.
In front of everyone, the young lady was scorned by Gu Qingshan in public, her reputation would be seriously damaged, and the two of them would be in chaos.
If there was another backhand hidden in the cocktail party, maybe the other party could take advantage of the chaos and find an opportunity to assassinate the young lady.
The white-haired old man flashed and was already standing in front of Zhang Ye.
"Come on, boy, the world is hard, why not fall into a dark and sweet dream."
The old man chanted, grabbed Zhang Ye's Tianling Cap with his rough hands, and slowly closed his eyes.
Something strange happened.
When the old man closes his eyes, Zhang Ye also closed his eyes.
The old man continued to chant in a weird tone, like a demon tempting mortals: "Come, come, come, just tell me your secret, and I will fulfill all the wishes in your heart."
Zhang Ye had a silly smile on his face and murmured: "I'll tell you, I'll tell you right away."
This strange scene attracted whispers from the crowd of onlookers.
Gu Qingshan also asked in surprise: "Is this a chosen skill?"
Su Xueer stood beside him and whispered: "Yes, Grandpa Li is a chosen one who is good at finding the truth."
The Chosen Ones are professionals who have mastered special abilities. These abilities are very mysterious and often appear gradually as a person grows and develops.
Such an ability cannot be learned through acquired practice, and no one can interfere. It is like it is destined by God.
Therefore, people with these abilities are called the Chosen Ones.
In the real world, the high-end combat power of the human race is divided into four categories, namely, the Chosen, the Martial, the Extraordinary, and the Divine. Each category focuses on a different direction.
